query: 统计全部订单的 GMV，只返回一列成交总额。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order

query: 统计华北地区全部订单的销售总额，只返回一列销售总额。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id WHERE r.region_name='华北'

query: 统计2025年第一季度各大区的GMV，按GMV从高到低排序。结果列依次为大区、GMV。
reference_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY gmv DESC

query: 统计2025年3月各商品品类的销量和销售额。结果列依次为品类、销量、销售额。
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.order_quantity) AS quantity, SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250301 AND 20250331 GROUP BY p.category

query: 查询华东地区2025年第一季度销售额最高的前5个商品，按销售额降序。结果列依次为商品名称、销售额。
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE r.region_name='华东' AND o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY p.product_id,p.product_name ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 5

query: 按会员等级统计2025年第一季度的订单数和销售额，每个order_id代表一个订单。结果列依次为会员等级、订单数、销售额。
reference_sql: SELECT c.member_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY c.member_level

query: 统计全部订单的平均订单金额，即销售总额除以订单数，不是每件商品的平均单价，只返回一列平均订单金额。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(order_amount)/COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM fact_order

query: 统计2025年第一季度每月的GMV，按月份升序。结果列依次为月份、GMV。
reference_sql: SELECT d.month, SUM(o.order_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_date d ON o.date_id=d.date_id WHERE d.year=2025 AND d.quarter='Q1' GROUP BY d.month ORDER BY d.month

query: 统计黄金会员购买的商品总件数，只返回一列件数。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_quantity) AS quantity FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE c.member_level='黄金'

query: 统计广东省全部订单数量，按order_id去重，只返回一列订单数。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_region r ON o.region_id=r.region_id WHERE r.province='广东省'

query: 统计苹果品牌商品的全部销售额，只返回一列销售额。
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(o.order_amount) AS amount FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.brand='苹果'

query: 列出2024年1月的订单，结果列依次为订单ID、订单金额。
reference_sql: SELECT order_id,order_amount FROM fact_order WHERE date_id BETWEEN 20240101 AND 20240131
